One AI agent rebuilt Terraria in 3D in 8 days. Solo devs just got a studio. 🤖

Claude Opus 5.5 built a complete 3D recreation with 3,369 items, 313 enemies and bosses, and 346,000 lines of custom C# code—all without touching a single line of human code.

No game engine. No framework. Just AI doing the work of a studio.
